purpose: Staging ledger for new pet-food barcode records found through Deep Research before promotion into data/known-products.ts and data/known-formulas.ts.

rules.new_only: Before adding a record, compare its canonical UPC/GTIN against data/known-products.ts, this ledger, and data/wrong-barcodes.ts.
rules.upc_storage: Store UPC/GTIN as a zero-padded string. Never store it as a number.
rules.barcode_scope: An individual unit UPC is required for promotion. Case, tray, variety-pack, and multipack codes must be identified explicitly and must not replace an individual-unit UPC.
rules.ingredients: Preserve the exact printed ingredient order. Do not shorten, tidy, reorder, infer, or repair OCR silently.
rules.incomplete_evidence: If the full label-order ingredient list, guaranteed analysis, calories, or barcode scope cannot be verified, use research_status=needs_physical_label and state exactly what is missing.
rules.source_priority: Official label/deck or a clear physical label beats an official product page; an official page beats a retailer. Record every material disagreement.
rules.promotion: A record is staging data only. Promotion to the catalog requires the repository seeding checks and explicit insertion into known-products.ts and known-formulas.ts.

status_values.candidate: Identity or barcode candidate found, but evidence is incomplete.
status_values.source_verified: Required fields are supported by authoritative label/deck evidence and arithmetic/check-digit checks pass.
status_values.needs_physical_label: A real package photo is needed to resolve missing, cropped, stale, or conflicting label data.
status_values.rejected: Duplicate, wrong product, case/multipack code used as unit code, invalid check digit, or otherwise unsuitable.
status_values.promoted_to_seed: Copied into the repository seed files after checks; keep the ledger entry for provenance.

record_contract.package_type: can | pouch | tub | tray | bag | box | other
record_contract.ingredients_verbatim: complete label text in printed order
ingredients_ordered_normalized: optional normalized ingredient names in the same order

calorie_content.unit_name: can | pouch | serving | cup | piece | other | null

verification_notes: check-digit, arithmetic, identity, or label notes
